description: Commit with an informative message body choosing httpx over requests/aiohttp.

commits.message:
Switch HTTP client to httpx

The fetcher now runs inside FastAPI handlers, so it must be async.
Considered aiohttp, but httpx offers the same sync/async API and
built-in HTTP/2, and its test transport lets us mock without a server.
requests was ruled out because it has no async support.

files.feedpull/fetch.py:
import httpx

_client = httpx.AsyncClient(http2=True, timeout=10)


async def fetch(url: str) -> bytes:
    response = await _client.get(url)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.content
